card.name: Verbs saying a product contains an allergen
card.fires_on: The word contain(s) or a nearby word in a phrase saying a product, needle cover, stopper or tablet holds latex, milk protein, antibiotic traces or an amino acid. It also fires on similar words in allergy warnings.

modes.label: Contains latex or trace allergen
modes.description: The verb contain after may, naming a device part or product that holds latex or traces of a substance.
modes.example: the needle shield may<< contain>> natural rubber latex which may cause allergic reactions

modes.label: Other allergen-source wording
modes.description: Words in the same warnings that point to the source of an ingredient, such as derived or a possessive for milk.
modes.example: Product manufacturing includes porcine- and bovine<<-derived>> reagents.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like ingredients, hidden and tainted, which suggests the text will name what a product is made of.
card.plain: It marks spots where a label says a product or its packaging contains an ingredient that could cause an allergy.
